_meta.purpose: The topic clusters that hold guides together. A cluster is a buyer question plus the axes that answer it; it is not a keyword bucket.
_meta.note: Everything in 'basis' is an assumption inherited from the brief's working titles, marked as such on the rendered page (FLG-005).

clusters.title: Air fryers, without the hype
clusters.question: What should a person actually compare when the marketing is identical on every box?
clusters.basis: The brief's suggested editorial hypotheses are all air-fryer and multi-function cooker topics. No listing data supports the assignment.

axes.name: Capacity you can use
axes.why: Advertised quarts measure the cavity, not what fits in one batch; a 6-quart basket still cooks a single layer of wings.
axes.verify_by: the listing's own capacity statement plus the internal dimensions if published

axes.name: Footprint and clearance
axes.why: The appliance has to live somewhere with vent clearance, and the counter is the scarce resource, not the outlet.
axes.verify_by: measured dimensions on the listing, a tape measure, and your own counter

axes.name: Cleanup surface area
axes.why: Coatings, baskets, trays and lids are where owners quit; this is the most common abandoned-appliance complaint pattern, and it is checkable from the parts list.
axes.verify_by: the parts diagram and the dishwasher-safe statement on the listing

axes.name: Controls you will actually use
axes.why: Oven-style units with dozens of presets trade a learning curve for buttons you may press twice. Multi-function claims only pay rent if you cook more than fried things.
axes.verify_by: the control description and the included-accessory list

clusters.review_by_basis: Seasonal copy is reviewed before its next season, not left to rot: promotional and seasonal sentences must be pulled once the underlying Amazon promotion ends.

clusters.title: Counter space and cleanup
clusters.question: Where will it live, and who washes it?
clusters.basis: Same inheritance as above; promoted to its own cluster because it is the angle the big review sites cover worst.

axes.name: Permanent vs. cupboard home
axes.why: Decide this before you buy, because it changes the size you should want more than any rating does.

axes.name: Cord and outlet geometry
axes.why: Short cords and rear vents kill otherwise good placements.
axes.verify_by: listing spec plus a tape measure

axes.name: Number of washable parts
axes.why: Parts count predicts abandonment better than taste does.

seasons.title: Holiday kitchen, 2026
seasons.angle: Oven is the bottleneck, not the counter: what a second heat source is actually for.
seasons.note: Deliberately not a deal page. No price or promotion language, per the gate: mentions of time-limited offers must be removed the moment they end.

seasons.title: January cooking reset, 2027
seasons.angle: The appliance you will still use in March.
